name: Owner Safe Pets
summary: Swing, shoot and blast away without worry: your tamed wolves, cats, parrots and horses never take damage from you.
logoPrompt: A single red leather pet collar with a small golden heart-shaped tag hanging from it, centred, in blocky voxel style

cover.tagline: Your pets are safe from your own sword.
bullets: No damage from hits or sweeps
Arrows and your TNT spare them

description: **Owner Safe Pets stops you from hurting your own animals, so a missed swing in a fight never costs you your dog.**
- Tamed wolves, cats and parrots take no damage from the player who tamed them.
- The same goes for tamed horses, donkeys, mules, llamas and camels.
- Covers direct hits, sword sweeps, arrows, tridents and explosions you caused, such as TNT you lit.
- A sitting wolf or parrot stays seated when you bump into it by mistake.
- Everyone else is unchanged: other players, mobs, fall damage and lava still hurt your pets.
Put the jar into the `mods` folder next to Fabric API. Tame an animal as usual and fight next to it; your hits pass it by.
- Made for Fabric Loader on Minecraft: Java Edition 1.21.1 and needs Fabric API.
- Works in singleplayer and on servers. On a server only the server needs it; players can join without installing anything.
- New features arrive with updates, see each file's changelog.
Found a bug or have an idea? Leave a comment.
